releaseNotes: Added an opt-in authenticated local MCP launcher for a running PixelWall desktop window, with inspection, bounded edits, progress polling, cancellation, previews, exports, and verified generated-file handoff.
Added retry-safe request keys, immutable preflight validation, observable operation progress, and cancellation between commands while preserving atomic document commits.
Added deterministic editable scene components for trees, rocks, river banks, bridges, and terrain accents, with named layers, shared palettes, bounded sizes, and reproducible seeds.
Added before/after artwork review previews and bounded local artifact storage with expiry, checksums, and explicit separation between file generation and browser download completion.
Updated the web editor, standalone browser edition, CLI, and desktop guidance for compact backups, legacy JSON reopening, local MCP setup, scene components, and agent recovery.
